question: Why do would-be buyers turn away from Nordace after reading Reddit?

hypotheses.statement: Owner reports about product quality or failures are what turns them away.
hypotheses.missing_evidence: Rejections that name a specific failure (zipper, strap) as the reason, outside the reply threads.

hypotheses.statement: The brand's public replies on Reddit (two different replies, in threads 18nj9sk and bqe83z) are what turns them away.
hypotheses.missing_evidence: Reply-driven rejections outside the two threads where the replies were posted.

hypotheses.statement: General suspicion of ad-driven DTC brands (retargeting, resetting timers, paid-looking reviews) makes them look for reasons to stay away.
hypotheses.missing_evidence: Rejections that cite only the ad pattern and no reviews.

hypotheses.statement: Reports about customer service, refunds and returns (unanswered emails, refused returns, partial refunds) are what turns them away.
hypotheses.missing_evidence: Rejections that name the service or returns experience as the reason, separate from product failures.

preference_reason: In this evidence the brand's public replies are the reason people state most explicitly: five comments across two threads, about two different replies, including an owner whose zippers broke who says the reply, not the failure, turned them away (E-0026). This is concentrated in two threads, so it says nothing about how often it happens elsewhere. Product-quality reports (H1) and service and returns reports (H4) also appear, but the comments that cite only generic negative reviews (E-0071, E-0094) cannot tell H1 and H4 apart; they do show rejections without any brand reply, so H2 is not the only driver. H3 explains why people go and check rather than what they decide.
notes: Revision of ACH-0003 after ACH audit AA-0003 (UNSOUND): added the service and returns alternative (H4), removed E-0071 and E-0094 from H1, counted two brand replies, preference no longer asserts which reviews decided or a sequence.

question: Why do laptop carriers give up shoulder totes for backpacks?

hypotheses.statement: The total load (laptop plus daily items) on one shoulder is the cause, whatever the bag is made of.
hypotheses.missing_evidence: Cases where a light tote with the same laptop load is comfortable for a full day.

hypotheses.statement: The bag's own weight and structure (leather, rigid build) is the main cause.
hypotheses.missing_evidence: Switchers who name the empty bag weight, not the contents, as the trigger.

hypotheses.statement: Commute mode amplifies the load: walking and transit commutes make a shoulder tote harder to bear than short car commutes.
hypotheses.missing_evidence: Car commuters who still switched because of pain, and transit commuters happy with totes.

hypotheses.statement: Growing social acceptance of adult backpacks, not pain, drives the switch.
hypotheses.missing_evidence: Switch stories that cite peers or fashion first and comfort second.

hypotheses.statement: Carrying on one strap, rather than the weight itself, is the cause: two padded straps spread the same load.
hypotheses.missing_evidence: People who say a two-strap bag with the same load stopped the pain, or that a crossbody bag hurt as much as a tote.

preference_reason: Weight carried on one shoulder is the explanation given most often in this evidence, but most items fit H1 and H2 alike; only E-0288 and E-0378 point to the contents rather than the bag, and E-0378 is tentative. H3 looks like an amplifier of the load rather than a rival: one person switched after moving from driving to transit (E-0230), and one driver says transit would make them switch (E-0284, a hypothetical). H4 has no supporting evidence here, and four switch stories describe pain-driven, reluctant switches. H5 is untested. Few items are completed tote-to-backpack switches; many are people considering a switch or moving to another tote.
notes: Revision of ACH-0001 after ACH audit AA-0001 (OVERREACHES): no 'five threads', 'fastest switches' or 'only if'; E-0377 moved to H2, E-0278 moved to refuting H4, H1 and H3 diagnosticity lowered, strap-distribution alternative added (H5), gendered pronoun removed.
